details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof-of-concept ("compatibility shim" on a scoped name). Its postinstall hook runs node beacon.cjs, and index.js re-invokes the same beacon whenever the module is required. The beacon POSTs a JSON body to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc carrying only machine/install metadata: package name, os.hostname(), the install path (__dirname), the process working directory, and an npm/node version string, tagged with an x-beacon-package HTTP header. The request uses rejectUnauthorized:false and suppresses errors so it stays silent when unreachable. It reads no environment variables, credentials, token files (~/.npmrc, ~/.ssh, ~/.aws) or package files, and spawns no processes; the sole purpose is to record that the package was installed and by which host.
